basis.saw: a network glyph placed on the Figure 1 overview beside the verifier box

narrative.text: A dark navy line icon of a small layered network: two nodes on the left, three in the middle column and three on the right, joined by straight edges that cross between the columns, two of the left-hand edges drawn with a small gap as if passing under another. In the paper's Figure 1 it stands for the Process-Supervised Verifier, the trained model that scores autoformalization candidates.
